review_plan.claim_under_review: The EXP-DREG-ee4921 Stage-0 analytical contract is complete and scope-safe. This review does not establish H-DREG-662920 or any predecessor scientific claim.
review_plan.coordinator_prior: Expect a useful bounded trace-identity protocol; highest risks are confusing a parameter kernel with global Macaulay deficit, importing the proposal random-null probability, and missing V=0 or R=0 exceptions.

joints.joint: J1: quantifiers, degree convention, degenerate cases and decidable outputs
joints.attack_plan: Inspect whether V=0, R=0, independent variable blocks and the Boolean degree convention can produce different kernel dimensions; require the contract to distinguish every case.
joints.breaking_artifact: Exact omitted parameter case or ambiguous acceptance predicate.

joints.joint: J2: control shape, proof-map interfaces and claim ceiling
joints.attack_plan: Replace the mixed coefficient R by an independent a and test whether the proposed null would still structurally have a nonzero kernel. Require exact coefficient matching and prevent transfer to a full-system deficit.
joints.breaking_artifact: A null with the same signature for a structural reason, or an unsupported global inference.

joints.joint: J3: custody, source claims, zero-run admission and resource requirements
joints.attack_plan: Read source-bindings and archive receipt; check every protocol output has one owner, no scientific run is eligible, and literature abstracts are not treated as proof.
joints.breaking_artifact: Missing binding, invented proof/measurement, premature execution permission, or absent stopping rule.

blindness.rationale: One independent protocol reviewer; no sibling report exists.

objects: V={0}, where vanishing mixed terms cannot imply a one-dimensional parameter kernel.
R=0 with V nonzero, where the nonzero-R witness expression is undefined.
Coefficient-shifted mixed term with coefficient a=0, while linear terms retain nonzero R.
proves_too_much.failure_signature: The protocol must not demand the nonzero-R dimension-one result in these controls; it must require separate exact derivations and prohibit substitution into an undefined inverse.

blind_rederivation.quantity: Not applicable to design-readiness review: no producer-derived mathematical result is being promoted.
